name: zz-stack
description: Delivery flows and platform tools for the ZZ platform. Every tool here is a door at the gateway and asks for your platform token; installing a plugin grants nothing on its own.

plugins.name: zz
plugins.description: REQUIRED — ZZ platform baseline for your team — identity, your team's documents and knowledge, the gates, and where each piece of work stands. Required by everything else.

plugins.name: zz-access
plugins.description: Access, yours and everybody's: your platform token, your keys for the building blocks, and the setup for whichever client you work in — plus, if your role carries them, the people, teams, flow installs and block grants behind them. One door; the tools you are offered are the ones your role can execute.

plugins.name: zz-block-eval
plugins.description: Measure an MCP surface: what it offers, what it honours of the standard, and what it does that its documentation does not describe. Points at any registered block — including 'platform', which is this platform's own surface.

plugins.name: zz-skill-eval
plugins.description: Measure a skill: its statistics first, then its definition of good, then its documents if it writes any. Produces evidence, never a change.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Software delivery: explore the ground, agree a spec, audit it, plan it, audit that, build it, review the code, then close it and hand it to zz-knowledge.
